## Mathematical area

Which domain is affected? For example: trees, branching fields, point
processes, kernels, Donsker limits, stable processes, or Mogulskii estimates.

## Proposed result

State the definition, theorem, or refactor as precisely as possible. Include a
reference to the paper or a Mathlib theorem when available.

## Suggested location

Which existing module should contain the result, or why should a new module be
introduced?

## Verification plan

What is the smallest Lean target or example that would demonstrate the result?
